extraction_method: Static ZIP extraction and scanning native library read-only data strings; XML well-formedness check with inert format placeholders. No APK or native code executed, no TV contacted.
offset_semantics: Byte offsets inside the uncompressed source_internal_path file, not offsets inside the APK ZIP.
scope: Loewe Tablet SOAP only. The APK itself is not part of this adapter package.
notes: Original templates contain printf placeholders. Do not send the placeholder templates directly.
The adapter uses an empty fcid and the ClientId returned by RequestAccess.
The AddServicesFavoriteList original has an unprefixed closing tag. The adapter repairs only that tag.
SetMute=1 is directly proven. SetMute=0 is inferred from the original response parser.
No real TV or running ioBroker controller was contacted during development.
